notes.title: Save Horses & Explore New Pasture Features in the Horse Designer
notes.content:
[h3]WHAT'S NEW?[/h3]

[list]
[*][b]Save Your Creations[/b] – You can now save the horses you create!
[*][b]View & Capture[/b] – Check out your saved horses in the pasture and take beautiful screenshots, whether in the editor or out in the field.
[*][b]More Variety[/b] – A wide range of new markings and coat variations are now available to make your horses truly unique.
[*][b]Revamped UI[/b] – The entire user interface has been redesigned for a smoother experience.
[*][b]Pasture Music Player[/b] – Enjoy a small built-in music player while spending time with your horses on the pasture.
[*][b]Updated Tack Options[/b] – Tack previews have been reworked.
[*][b]Improved Animations[/b] – Horse animations have been polished and enhanced for more realism.
[*][b]Polished Horse Look[/b] – The overall appearance of the horses has been refined and improved.
[*][b]New Game Design[/b] – A fresh game logo and updated design give the game a brand-new look.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44302360/2c8f4e2765f75204b808adb83d3a6b83c3e5bbe2.png[/img]
